security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost ws://localhost:1420; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: System-wide translation from a global hotkey
bundle.longDescription: Select text anywhere and press a hotkey, or crop a region of the screen, and LM Translate returns the translation in a small popup. Works the same regardless of which application is in the foreground.
